context: Riku tells Aoi about a school sports day.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (優勝/困難/不足/級/少なく) in natural home.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 運動会で、僕のクラスが優勝したよ!
lines.en: My class won the sports day!
lines.style: excited teen boy voice, bright warm eager delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: すごい!優勝なんて、立派だね。
lines.style: cheerful barista voice, soft warm delighted delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 練習は、けっこう困難だったんだ。
lines.style: reflective teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 人数が、少なくて大変だった?
lines.en: Was it hard with so few people?
lines.style: curious barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん、人手不足で困難だったよ。
lines.en: Yeah, it was tough with a shortage of hands.
lines.style: honest teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 上の級の子たちも、出たの?
lines.en: Did the upper-grade kids compete too?
lines.style: engaged barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 上級生は少なくて、僕らが頑張った。
lines.en: There were few seniors, so we worked hard.
lines.style: proud teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 困難を越えての優勝、最高だね!
lines.style: bubbly barista voice, soft warm closing delivery throughout
